ufw_enabled.description: Whether the firewall is active on boot.

default_input_policy.description: Default policy for incoming traffic. Acceptable values: DROP, ACCEPT, REJECT.

default_output_policy.description: Default policy for outgoing traffic. Acceptable values: DROP, ACCEPT, REJECT.

default_forward_policy.description: Default policy for routed/forwarded traffic. Acceptable values: DROP, ACCEPT, REJECT.

ipv6_enabled.description: Enable IPv6 firewall rules in addition to IPv4.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. 'off' disables most logging; 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'full' increase detail.

log_file.description: Path to the main UFW log file.

max_log_size.description: Maximum log entries per minute before throttling begins. Set to 0 to disable throttling.

ipt_sysctl.description: Explicit iptables backend to use ('iptables-legacy' or 'iptables-nft'). 'auto' lets UFW detect the system default.

ipt_options.description: Extra command-line options passed to iptables. Use with caution — only for advanced tuning.

log_denied.description: Whether to log denied packets independently of LOGLEVEL. Acceptable values: off, rules, all.

raw_ipv6.description: Allow raw IPv6 packets through the firewall. Should be false unless required for special cases.

allow_udp_frag.description: Allow fragmented UDP packets. Generally should be false for security.

ipt_modules.description: Extra connection tracking modules to load. Typically empty for new installations.
